fusions.name: Drift Net
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone that deals 4 damage to everything in it and has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tidal Shove
fusions.desc: A surge that deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 2 tiles. It leaves the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Calm Water
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. You also regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.
